author: Ayeda Okambawa
name: RawForge
description: Sends selected RAW files to the external RawForge tool to denoise/refine them and produces a cleaner DNG back in darktable.
description-extensive: Sends your RAW files to the separate RawForge program to reduce noise and clean them up, then brings the improved DNG version back into darktable. It requires the RawForge tool to be installed.
